notes.title: Hotfix 1.1
notes.notes:
- Fixed a bug where you could get stuck on a trampoline.
- Fixed the controls HUD sometimes persisting after the tutorial section.
- Made slightly more forgiving collision to some parts of the wind / ice sections.
- Fixed an issue with the ending movie sometimes not playing.

notes.title: Handstand Hank out now!
notes.notes: [p]Get ready to [i]Jump, Fall and Rage[/i] as Handstand Hank is out now![/p][p][/p][p]Handstand Hank is a punishing experience inspired by foddian games like Getting Over It, Jump King and A Difficult Game About Climbing. For those looking for an unforgiving platformer hard mode is recommended![/p][p][/p][p]Special thanks to all of the demo players, friends and family who helped shape the game into what it is today.[/p]

notes.title: 1,000 Demo Players Milestone
notes.notes: [h2]Thank you to Over 1,000 Players![/h2][p][/p][p]More than 1,000 of you have played Handstand Hank's demo, thank you so much![/p][p][/p][p]Whether you played for just a few minutes or spent hours mastering the controls, your time and feedback have been incredibly valuable. Watching you play and create content has helped me identify and improve areas in both level design and gameplay feel.[/p][p][/p][p]With June Next Fest around the corner, I’m excited for more people to experience a demo that’s been polished thanks to all the feedback you've shared with me![/p]

notes.title: New Demo Level
notes.notes:
[h3]What's Changed:[/h3]
[list]
[*] A clearer tutorial section teaching short jumps
[*] Vertically designed level to make the falls less brutal and time to reset reduced
[*] Safety catches so hard mode is more forgiving now.
[/list]

[h3]Movement Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Removed the ability for the player to move while ascending as this was not an intended movement mechanic but many started to use it but would make them fall later in the course causing fustration.
[*] Polished the movement and jump mechanic allowing for simultaneous pressing and within ~0.1 seconds of each other.
[/list]

[h3]Thank you![/h3]
The 800+ of you that have played the demo have provided me with incredibly useful feedback for the pain points you all had during the original demo (many with the flag poles). I will work on improving Handstand Hank taking in your feedback from your gameplay and videos online so that the final release can be a better experience for you all!

notes.title: Handstand Hank's Demo is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Get ready for a new 3D Foddian-style platformer that will test your patience and precision! In Handstand Hank's Demo, you’ll jump, fall and traverse your way through a treacherous mountain of obstacles! Each fall brings with it the pain of regret but also the potential to achieve glorious new heights! 

[h3]Your Climb Awaits you![/h3]
